title: Bitcoin’s 14th Difficulty Reset Slashes Mining Pressure by 6.7 Trillion
summary:
1. Bitcoin’s mining difficulty fell 5% on July 11, dropping to 127.17 trillion in the network’s 14th adjustment of 2026 and pulling the metric closer to its low for the year.
2. The adjustment landed at block height 957600.
3. Difficulty moved from 133.87 trillion to 127.17 trillion, a decline of roughly 6.70 trillion.
